name: Soothing Spices
summary: In Dustwallow Marsh, "Swamp Eye" Jarl needs three Soothing Spices for a stew.

sections.title: Spice for the Pot
sections.body: "Swamp Eye" Jarl loves swamp cooking, including fried green frog legs. Now Jarl plans a stew and needs soothing spice for the pot. Bring three Soothing Spices, and Jarl will share the stew with you. Does stew suit your taste?

faq.answer: "Swamp Eye" Jarl wants the soothing spices. Jarl is found in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: What does Swamp Eye Jarl intend to cook with the spices?
faq.answer: Jarl plans to cook a stew with the spices and share it with you. Jarl enjoys swamp cooking, including fried green frog legs.

faq.q: How many spices does Jarl need?
